value_types.definition: Human-readable string that is not itself a coded concept.
Lossless source JSON value before semantic normalization.
value_types.representation: JSON null, scalar, array, or object

value_types.definition: Identifier scoped by an assigning system and optional use/type.
Stable reference to another versioned object.
Source text plus zero or more versioned terminology codings.
Discriminated clinical value: text, coded, quantity, range, ratio, boolean, integer, date-time, period, reference, or missing.
Point, period, relative or raw time with precision and certainty.
Number with comparator, display unit and optional versioned unit code.
Lifecycle or epistemic status from a declared value set.
Ordered or set-like list of stable object references as defined by the field.
List of CodeableConcept values without implying equivalence between codings.
Evidence references with role, strength, rationale and target scope.
References to activities, agents and entities responsible for generation or revision.
List of strings whose item semantics are defined by the owning field.
Namespaced extensions that retain unknown information without redefining core fields.

fields.definition: Project-internal immutable identity for one versioned object.
fields.prohibited_interpretation: A display label or terminology code is not the object identity.

fields.definition: Identifiers assigned by source systems, institutions or controlled project namespaces.
fields.null_semantics: Empty means no identifier was supplied; it does not mean the object has no identity.
fields.prohibited_interpretation: Identifiers from different systems cannot be compared by value alone.

fields.definition: Reference to the person or group about whom the statement is made.
fields.null_semantics: Null means the subject is unknown or not applicable and must be explained by context.

fields.definition: Encounter or visit contexts to which the object applies.
fields.null_semantics: Empty means no encounter association is known, not that the event occurred outside care.

fields.definition: References to source documents, records, files or packages from which the object derives.
fields.null_semantics: Formal candidates require at least one source or an explicit no-direct-source state.

fields.definition: Links evidence to a claim with supporting, weak-supporting, counterevidence, ambiguous or contextual role.
fields.null_semantics: Empty requires an explicit no-direct-evidence or synthetic status for inferential objects.
fields.prohibited_interpretation: Supporting evidence does not by itself prove a claim.

fields.definition: References to activities, agents and entities responsible for creation, transformation or review.
fields.null_semantics: Empty is allowed only for imported legacy candidates and creates a quality warning.

fields.definition: BCP-47 language tag for the represented content.
fields.null_semantics: Null means not recorded, not that language is irrelevant.

fields.definition: Jurisdiction in which a rule, terminology, guideline or record context applies.
Field name exactly as observed in the source occurrence.
fields.null_semantics: Null is allowed for unkeyed narrative spans.
fields.prohibited_interpretation: The raw key is not a canonical semantic identifier.

fields.definition: Lossless JSON-compatible value as observed before correction or normalization.
fields.null_semantics: JSON null means the source explicitly contained no value; absence of the field is invalid.
fields.prohibited_interpretation: Normalized text must never overwrite this value.

fields.definition: Observed representation type before clinical interpretation.
fields.null_semantics: Use unknown rather than null when not determined.

fields.definition: Path within a source structure, page region, table, section or nested record.
fields.null_semantics: Null means unavailable; evidence location may still supply another locator.

fields.definition: Context necessary to interpret a source occurrence without changing its value.
Source-preserving concept with text and zero or more terminology codings.
fields.null_semantics: Null means not mapped; the raw value remains authoritative.
fields.prohibited_interpretation: Multiple codings are mappings, not proof that entire terminology systems are equivalent.

fields.definition: Typed value derived from the raw value without deleting the raw representation.
fields.null_semantics: Null means normalization has not produced a value.

fields.definition: Lifecycle state of the object, distinct from patient state and review status.
Whether the observation or claim is present, absent, conditional or unknown.
fields.null_semantics: Use unknown; null is not permitted after normalization.
fields.prohibited_interpretation: Polarity is not confidence or verification status.

fields.definition: Degree of epistemic certainty without converting it into a clinical probability.
fields.prohibited_interpretation: Low, medium and high are ordinal labels unless a calibrated method is declared.

fields.definition: Time or period during which the observed fact or state is asserted as true.
fields.null_semantics: Null means the clinical time is unknown.

fields.definition: Time at which an assertion or provenance activity was recorded, distinct from clinical effective time.
Anatomical sites relevant to an observation, condition or action.
fields.null_semantics: Empty means not captured or not applicable.

fields.definition: Method used to obtain an observation or perform an action.
Categorical interpretations such as high, low, abnormal, improved or worsened.
Whether information came from patient, caregiver, practitioner, device, document, model or rule.
Actors, devices or organizations that performed or participated in an event.
Whether content was imported, rule-derived, model-generated or human-authored.
Unreviewed, confirmed or rejected status assigned through an auditable review activity.
fields.null_semantics: Defaults to unreviewed; never infer confirmation from model confidence.
fields.prohibited_interpretation: Model output cannot set human-confirmed status.

fields.definition: Population, setting, temporal, jurisdictional or other conditions under which a claim applies.
fields.null_semantics: Empty means unspecified scope and must not be interpreted as universal.

fields.definition: Reason an expected value is missing, distinct from absent clinical findings.
fields.null_semantics: Null means no missing-value statement was made.
fields.prohibited_interpretation: Missing data is not a negative clinical finding.

fields.definition: Distinguishes historical, planned, recommended, ordered, performed, stopped and hypothetical actions.
fields.null_semantics: Use unknown for imported legacy actions.
fields.prohibited_interpretation: A historical or hypothetical action is not a current recommendation.

fields.definition: Traceable extension values used only when the common registry cannot yet express source information.
fields.prohibited_interpretation: Extensions cannot silently redefine a core field.

fields.definition: Declared medical reasoning system or systems in which an assertion is made, without implying equivalence across systems.
fields.null_semantics: At least one declared system is required for reasoning objects.
fields.prohibited_interpretation: TCM and Western concepts are not interchangeable merely because both profiles are enabled.

fields.definition: Inspection, listening/smelling, inquiry or palpation domain for a TCM observation.
fields.null_semantics: Null means the source does not assign a four-diagnostic domain.

fields.definition: TCM-specific etiological factor linked to evidence and applicability.
fields.null_semantics: Empty means no TCM etiology candidate.

fields.definition: TCM disease location such as zang-fu, meridian, qi/blood level or other sourced location concept.
TCM nature of the condition, retained separately from location and syndrome.
Evidence-linked dynamic TCM mechanism; not interchangeable with disease or syndrome labels.
fields.prohibited_interpretation: A syndrome code does not automatically establish a pathomechanism.

fields.definition: TCM syndrome or pattern candidate with terminology version and verification status.
Primary, secondary, concomitant or candidate role within one encounter state.
Encounter-scoped root/branch relationship between TCM mechanisms or states.
High-level TCM treatment principle derived from a reviewed mechanism and safety context.
fields.null_semantics: Empty means no treatment principle candidate.

fields.definition: TCM treatment method distinguished from a concrete formula, herb or procedure.
fields.prohibited_interpretation: A treatment method is not a prescription.

fields.definition: Time-scoped transformation from one TCM state or mechanism to another.
Standardized sign, symptom, measurement or presentation used in Western clinical reasoning.
Evidence-linked factor associated with a defined clinical risk and population.
fields.null_semantics: Empty means no risk factor captured.

fields.definition: Western pathophysiological mechanism, separate from TCM pathomechanism.
Western diagnosis or condition with clinical and verification status.
Alternative diagnosis candidate with supporting, counter and missing evidence.
fields.null_semantics: Empty means no differential list was produced.

fields.definition: Requested, historical or resulted investigation, distinguished by action kind and status.
Risk category produced by an identified method, version and applicable population.
fields.prohibited_interpretation: An uncalibrated model confidence is not a clinical risk score.

fields.definition: Western intervention distinguished as historical, planned, recommended, ordered or performed.
Evidence-scoped prognosis or expected course with method and uncertainty.
Evidence-linked safety signal evaluated under a named policy and version.
fields.null_semantics: Empty means none recorded, not that risk has been excluded.

fields.definition: Unassessed, blocked, restricted or cleared state within an explicit scope.
Versioned policies or guidelines applied by the safety assessment.
fields.null_semantics: Empty means no policy was applied and clearance cannot be assumed.

fields.definition: Actions or output classes that are blocked or degraded by the safety assessment.
fields.null_semantics: Empty means no explicit restriction recorded, not implicit clearance.

fields.definition: Requirement for emergency evaluation, referral, testing or human review.
Versioned identity and sourced name of a formula.
Reference to reusable intrinsic herb knowledge, not a duplicated herb definition.
Role of one herb in this formula and state, separate from intrinsic herb properties.
fields.null_semantics: At least one role is required when represented.

fields.definition: Dose bound to formula, preparation, source and clinical context.
fields.null_semantics: Null means dose unavailable; it must not be guessed.

fields.definition: Preparation or processing method relevant to the formula context.
Evidence-linked relation among ingredients within a particular formula.
Condition-action rule for a sourced formula adjustment.
fields.null_semantics: Empty means no adjustment rule represented.

fields.definition: Condition under which a formula action should stop, change or require review.
fields.null_semantics: Empty means no stop rule represented and must not imply unrestricted continuation.

fields.definition: Candidate transition expected after a formula action, distinct from observed outcome.
fields.prohibited_interpretation: Expected transition is not observed efficacy.

relations.definition: Source evidence increases support for a candidate within stated scope.
relations.prohibited_interpretation: Support is not proof or confirmation.

relations.definition: Evidence is compatible but has low specificity or indirectness.
Evidence decreases support or conflicts with a candidate.
relations.prohibited_interpretation: Counterevidence does not automatically refute the claim.

relations.definition: Target was generated or transformed from source through a recorded activity.
Source expression maps to a canonical concept under a versioned mapping rule.
relations.prohibited_interpretation: A mapping is not identity between entire medical systems.

relations.definition: A case-scoped object is an instance candidate of a sourced general concept or pattern.
Source event occurs before target event with declared temporal certainty.
relations.prohibited_interpretation: Temporal precedence alone is not causation.

relations.definition: A sourced or inferred causal candidate with conditions and review status.
Cross-system concepts share a supported relation without semantic equivalence.
A state changes to another state under time, action and uncertainty context.
relations.prohibited_interpretation: Predicted and observed transitions must use different assertion statuses.

profiles.purpose: Shared identity, source, clinical context, typed values, evidence, provenance and governance fields.
profiles.routing_rule: Always enabled. Specialized profiles may reference but never redefine these fields.

profiles.purpose: TCM four examinations, etiology, location, nature, pathomechanism, syndrome, treatment and transformation.
profiles.routing_rule: Enable only for sourced TCM observations, knowledge or reasoning. Do not use TCM fields to encode Western mechanisms.

profiles.purpose: Phenotype, pathophysiology, diagnosis, differential, investigation, risk, intervention and prognosis.
profiles.routing_rule: Enable for Western clinical assertions. Shared observations remain in common; do not translate TCM pathomechanisms into Western diagnoses.

profiles.purpose: Red flags, safety gate, policy, restriction and escalation fields with priority over professional reasoning.
profiles.routing_rule: Evaluate independently and in parallel. Unassessed, blocked or restricted status cannot be overridden by TCM or Western profiles.

profiles.purpose: Formula identity, reusable herb references, contextual roles, dose, preparation, compatibility and control rules.
profiles.routing_rule: Enable only after reviewed TCM state and safety context. Intrinsic herb knowledge and formula-specific role must remain separate.

governance.unknown_field_policy: Preserve the raw occurrence and use a namespaced extension or unmapped status; never drop or guess a core field.
governance.unknown_concept_policy: Keep source text, emit zero or more candidates, and mark unmapped or ambiguous. Never invent an external terminology code.
governance.profile_override_policy: A specialized profile may add fields but may not redefine a common field or another profile's field.
governance.ai_usage_policy: AI and Skill calls must declare registry version and enabled profiles; human confirmation cannot be inferred from model output.
governance.change_policy: Any semantic change requires a version increment, migration note, registry validation and regression tests. Package-local files cannot redefine registry semantics.
